title: Choosing collections
summary: Pick the right List, Set, Map or Deque for the job, and avoid the classic collection gotchas.

questions.prompt: Keep the 5 most recent searches: add each new one at the end and drop the oldest from the front. Which structure fits best?
A shop looks up products by SKU thousands of times per second and never needs them in order. Which structure?
What usually happens if you call list.remove(item) inside a for-each loop over that same ArrayList?
options: A ConcurrentModificationException on the next iteration
The removed item is skipped and everything works
The loop silently restarts from the beginning

questions.prompt: Complete the line so every blank name is removed from the list.
